english.title: Alter / deface / obscure / remove identification on a pedicab vehicle relating to London pedicab vehicle licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse

(A)_[altered or defaced the means of identification that had been issued for a pedicab vehicle to which a London pedicab vehicle licence related]_
(B)_[obscured the means of identification on a pedicab vehicle to which a London pedicab vehicle licence related]_
(C)_[removed the means of identification from a pedicab vehicle to which a London pedicab vehicle licence related]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation6(4) and (6) of the Pedicab Vehicles (London) Regulations 2026.
